mission.title: Strata
mission.description: Use a viral code to take control of one of the General's access points and find out where his forces come from.

npc.say: Buona fortuna, {player}! I know that you will perform your duties admirably!
Be very careful with the virus, {player}. It must be applied only to the specified system.
Strike force 91.A's auxiliary contingent has already been dispatched. They will continue with their pursuit of the terrorist hovercraft after the Exile target has been eliminated.

phase.briefing:
Operative, a viral code has been developed that will give us temporary control over one of the General's access points. This will allow us to find out where his forces are coming from, and, potentially, the location of the Exile program Sati.
You will collect the code from Agent Pace.

enter.say: Ah, Agent Pace. Life is good.

objective.text: Get the Virus from Agent Pace

talk.say: It is wonderful to see you, {player}! I have the virus that you must use to capture one of the General's access points. Please be so kind as to take it from me.
I wish we had a virus that would let us capture one of her-- Oh, never mind. Just, uh, get the program from her.

phase.briefing: Proceed to the target, {player}. You must reach the access point before the General's programs shut it down.

enter.say: Looks like an active access point in there. I don't see any of the General's standard commando programs in the code stream, but I betcha he's got a few of his sneaky red-eyed ones skulking around nearby.
There's the access point... Coast is clear, right?

objective.text: Put the Virus in the Computer

done.say: Well, it's nice to have an easy mission for once. I think you can get out of there now.

phase.briefing: Operative, there is a minor problem. The General's programs have intercepted the virus at one of their network hubs, and are currently attempting to delete it. They must be prevented from doing so.

enter.say:
Faster than a speeding virus...
Okay, you'll have to take out any hostile programs in there, and access the hub system to re-route the virus.

objective.text: Kill all of the hostile programs

done.say: Got 'em all? You sure? I guess I'll have to take your word for it.
Hm? A status report... Sounds like a base of some kind.

complete.say: All right, the virus is back on track.

phase.briefing: Good. We have begun to receive information from the commandeered access point. Agent Pace will brief you on some of the initial findings.

enter.say: Hey, ask her out this time! Don't wuss out again!

talk.say: Congratulazioni, {player}! Thanks to you, our virus has been able to infiltrate the General's network, and detect the staging ground where he has based his Sentinel forces on the Earth's surface. The commandos refer to it by a code name, "Stalingrad." Now it is only a matter of time before we capture this base, and eliminate the threat that his forces pose to the simulation! It is perhaps also the location through which he controls access to the stolen program, Sati.

done.say: Ah, you needn't worry, tesoro! Our own Sentinel forces are more than capable of dealing with the General's remaining machines in what you call the "Real."
The threat will be dealt with.
Do not be concerned. The Exile Sentinel forces are insufficient to withstand our assault.

mission.finish: Yes. As Agent Pace emphasized, operative, now that we have located his stronghold, the General's elimination is assured.
